company_info.company_description: "Lenergy's core focus is to accelerate sustainability by providing renewable energy & efficient solar solutions for households and businesses.We believe that everyone deserves access to clean, reliable and affordable energy and we're committed to making that dream a reality. We are dedicated to delivering the highest quality products, packages and service to our customers.Our sunburnt country is the perfect place for solar power and there are many benefits that come with it. Forget poor-quality, one size fits all systems. Our team of designers will work with you through the design process to maximise your properties solar potential and listen to your needs.Our in-house team of solar installers and electricians will keep you updated every step of the way throughout the installation. Once your install is completed, our full-time after sales service crew is at your disposal for maintenance and support and are dedicated to answering all of your questions.We want you to be proud of your investment in solar and reap the energy bill savings in the process."

reviews.review_description: Lenergy was polite tidy and punctual in installing the battery. They helped me understand the whole process and how the charger worked. I would totally recommend Lenergy to everyone.
From start to finish...the crew from Lenergy were fantastic. Very informative, price was good, arrived on time, installed in quick time, and cleaned up after. The follow up has been great.

Communication was A1, the team was very friendly and professional. Clearly describing the functions of the system for someone who isn’t electrically inclined. Price is very good for the quality of product ! Honestly made solar easy as well as an app to track it all. Installation was a breeze and was zero mess to clean up. I would highly recommend the team at Lenergy.

Lenergy were professional and honest.  They were not the cheapest quote but I understood that and expected to pay more for a high level of service and product.  They came onsite during the quoting process and explained the whole process.  There was a delay waiting for parts, but they stayed in touch and were prompt and reliable from that point onwards.  Happy to recommend Lenergy.

Lenergy did a replacement job for me where batteries on my standalone system needed replacing. I later chose to add more.They were efficient to quote. The installer was great at addressing many teething problems, tidy, polite.

Just one phone call and we were on our way. The on site visit was great, this gave us a better perspective of what to expect. All questions were answered. The installation went off without a glitch. The team were polite and cleaned up afterwards. All connection with our power supply was done with Lenergy  the team kept in contact with us before and after. The app is a great resource as I can see whn to start my appliances to get the best saving. What a great local businesses I would recommend you any time.

Lenergy gave clear advice and a number of options. They have considerable experience and were up to data with the latest technology.The installation was punctual, efficient and occurred without problem. Commissioning was delayed on their advice to qualify for the new rebate. the Sigenergy system is excellent. it is flexible and reports useful parameters to get the best out of it.
I cannot fault Lenergy, from the initial site visit to the technicians that attended and followup. One of the best for customer service in todays world. Great communication and punctual.

How was the sales/quoting process?Straight forward and with sufficient detailHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?All three of the aboveHow was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install, or show you how to use the charger?All technical concerns were answered/ resolved to my satisfaction.  I was impressed with some customized videos relating to my needs.Lenergy staff are polite, professional and technically competent.  I have used them for many years.  Earlier this year they assisted me to assess damage done to my solar system by a lightning strike.  And subsequently identified/ replaced damaged equipment to get the solar system working again.More recently I chose Lenergy to scale up my battery capacity and I am very happy with the result.Lenergy communicates well with its customers

We purchased solar panels (LONGi) with a view to adding a battery 6mths later.  The solar panel installation included battery readiness (ie hybrid inverter (SunGrow Hybrid 3 phase) and cabling) and 6mths later we added the battery (SunGrow). Post install was excellent (we had one issue and Lenergy fixed it straight away).Highly recommend Lenergy and they are local to the Southern Highlands!

I couldn’t be more impressed with the level of service provided by Lenergy. From the initial sales consultation through to installation and ongoing customer service, the entire process was seamless and professional.The sales team were knowledgeable, transparent, and took the time to explain the system design, performance expectations, and cost savings without any pressure. The installation crew arrived on time, worked efficiently, and maintained a clean and safe worksite throughout the job. The quality of workmanship was excellent and clearly done with attention to detail.What truly sets this company apart is their customer service. They were responsive, helpful, and genuinely committed to ensuring everything was operating perfectly after installation. Any questions were answered promptly, and follow-up support has been exceptional.If you're considering solar, I highly recommend this company. Their professionalism, communication, and quality of work exceeded expectations in every way.

From start to finish Lenergy were extremely professional and reliable and easy to deal with. Theirs was not the cheapest quote but I felt like they recommended a high quality system tailored to my needs. They didn't try to oversell and I feel that what I ended up with matches my needs perfectly. I had one small issue early on, more of a misunderstanding, but this was dealt with in a very responsive and responsible fashion. I've had zero issues since. Highly recommend Lenergy.
From first contact, quoting through installation and commissioning, Lenergy were prompt, communicative and very professional.We continue to enjoy considerable savings on our power bills.

A few months ago Lenergy supplied and installed a Hinen 5kW inverter and 15kWh-class battery system to work with my existing solar array, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.The value for money was excellent, and the customer service from start to finish was outstanding.Communication was clear, prompt and honest, and the installation team was professional, tidy and clearly knew their stuff.The system itself has been performing brilliantly, with the HINEN batteries and smart meter integrating seamlessly into my setup.Overall, I’m extremely satisfied and would happily recommend Lenergy to anyone looking for a quality solar and battery installation.

With so many different solar batteries currently available on the market, and almost as many companies selling them, finding a reputable company and fit-for-purpose solar battery option proved harder than expected. The Lenergy sales manager was excellent  - and gave honest, transparent and extremely helpful advice with various priced options available.Followup with the company to arrange an installation date was disappointing as I had to chase them numerous times before a mutually suitable date was agreed upon.The installation team on the day are to be commended for their punctuality, courtesy, professionalism and excellent communication. The final result is a neat and tidy set of batteries working without an issues. I was assisted to install the user app on my phone and the system was fully operational by the close of day.Would highly recommend Lenergy to others.
Excellent service ,quoted and installed ahead of schedule would highly recommend.

I found Lenergy to be very helpful and easy to deal with right from the beginning of the quoting process through to supply and implementation.  We decided to go with a frame mounted solar panel array in the paddock at the back of our house (for various reasons including the orientation and shading of our house which was not optimal for power production from a roof based installation) which resulted in additional costs and some delays due to weather etc, but the support from Lenergy was excellent throughout the process. Lenergy showed me how to use the Tesla App to monitor the performance of the system and I found it very easy to use.

The quoting process was excellent, they came on site and did a great site inspection. They were polite, tidy and punctual. This was also how the conducted themselves during the install and handover. It was a real end-to-end job.
Thanks to the team, great quoting process, explained well, value for money and a great home investment, cheers

Lenergy were fantastic to deal with during our recent battery installation.  We shopped around a lot before deciding to go with them.  The sales team were professional,  not pushy and the most knowledgeable that we experienced during the quotation process.  We could actually understand what they were offering and they could explain what we were getting and savings that would be possible.  Great communication from the whole team,  installation was smooth, fast and effective. Nice and clean throughout the process.  Very happy with our battery storage system.
We are so happy with Lenergy solar. Lincoln was so good to work with.If you are thinking of getting solar please try Lenergy you won’t be sorry.Garry

Having an on site inspection and being able to discuss my needs with a knowledgeable sales rep ( who then came back as part of the installation team) gave me real confidence form the beginning. Lenergy's quote was the most cost effective of the three I obtained. None of the other companies did a sight inspection, relying on google earth for their information.Installation was on time, efficient, tidy and careful. The team were friendly and courteous, they all seemed to know their job.The system was up and running on the afternoon of the installation and has continued to produce  "bulk urgs"  since September 2022 without faultLenergy also fitted our house with ducted air conditioning. Again nothing but praise and appreciation for an excellent job.  Again their quote was the best of three.I would have no hesitation in recomending Lenergy to anyone looking to instal solar power or air conditioning.Jim   Burradoo.
The site inspection sales process was excellent, Lenergy understood our particular needs and requirements. The installation team and work was quick and seamless and removed all the packaging.
Lenergy were prompt and easy to deal with. They listened to our requirements and gave us the best advice. Always available to answer any questions.

From tech proposal, to tricky installation (integrating with an older existing system), to admin follow up, to ongoing support and reliable system performance, Lenergy has been a pleasure to deal with. And my energy cost savings are significant.

I went through Solar Quotes for a solar installation on our new build in Goulburn NSW.Lenergy promptly responded with a quote that was competitively priced with quality components.  However it didn't stop there.  They came out and viewed the house and discussed with us our energy needs; difficult to do on a new build with no previous data.I always felt that they were selling me a solution to my energy needs rather than just selling a system.  As a result, we have ended up with a system that meets our expectations at minimum but exceeds in many.And the support didn't stop there.  They checked up about six weeks after the system was commissioned to make sure it was working to specifications and we were happy.The quality of service is such that I am now working with the Lenergy team to add a battery to our existing system.  And they are across the energy market suggesting options that will reduce costs.  And they always happy to take my calls.I wholeheartedly recommend the team at Lenergy to anybody seeking a new system or adding to an existing installation.
The solar installation team were quick thorough and efficient, had to come back to deal with an old circuit board needed replacing for connection all done and working well, thanks

Gave us several solar/battery options via explanatory videos and quotes.Finally recommended an excellent battery only option to take. Advantage of the Fed subsidy and a retailer with a free energy windowInstalled very well with minimal disruption to our life.After sales service has been great - particularly with remote battery management and a follow-up visit to correct a wiring problem from the solar system.
Winston was a very professional and easy to work with the crew done a great job with the installation they went why and beyond i was very happy

Lenergy are by far the best solar installers and suppliers we have ever dealt with far exceeding the services received from two previous companies on our old properties.Lenergy not only supplied a competitive quotation but also supplied a high quality product and installation service.We have 8-5 kilowatts on the roof and are getting value for money on our return due to the top quality panelsWe highly recommend Lenergy for their initial supply and installation and for their ongoing panel maintenance
Very happy with the whole process and installation.It's been a good investment

From the time Lenergy responded to our request for a quote we were very happy.  We were offered options in terms of quality of systems.  The system was an add-on to a smaller system after we had an extension completed.  Installation was scheduled for just a few weeks after we accepted the quote.The team arrived on time, got on with the job, explained everything well in the hand-over process and left no mess behind.  We have never had to call them back for the solar system as there have been no problems.We have since recommended Lenergy to two neighbours - one has installed, the other will get a quote soon.  I think this shows our satisfaction - and we will recommend them again to others when asked.As we were very happy we then had Lenergy clean all the panels, extend our existing reverse cycle aircon system, and do a full annual service. Once again the team were on time, professional and left no mess.

Winston and his team did a great job with our solar install. From dealing with Winston during the sales stage to the team on the ground doing the instal, they were very professional, friendly and did a great job. Definitely recommend them to potential customers
Happy with installation and after service care. Would recommend Lenergy.

I cannot recommend Lenergy enough. They are an amazing company from initial quotation to installation to questions I have months or even a year or two later. Lovely people that work there and always friendly. The quality of work is outstanding and the setup is clean and organised. Thank you Lenergy.

Lenergy recently installed my solar system and the entire experience was exceptional. The team was professional, efficient, and communicated clearly throughout the process. Installation was completed on time with great attention to detail, and the system has been performing exactly as promised. Their customer service was friendly, knowledgeable, and made everything hassle-free. I’d highly recommend Lenergy to anyone considering solar. Great price, great service, great result.
Post black summer Lenergy installed a 6.6W panel and Redback Lithium Battery.Also renovated antique circuit board in old home.5 years on now, harvesting sunlight!Thank you.
Excellent in all aspects. Would recommend this company to friends and family.
The team were very professional and constructive from start to finish.

After going for a ‘too good to be true’ solar installation on our roof many years ago, it turned out that we got what we paid for. We had to bring Lenergy in to take it all down only two years later., doing an expanded ground based installation then adding a few Tesla Powerwall batteries. We also have friends who’ve used Lenergy and everyone happy in an industry that’s very competitive with wildly varying after sales support. I’m guessing that today’s government subsidies are a honeypot for the fly by nighters as was the case with our original installation.

Lenergy went to great lengths to understand my needs. We had several phone calls and email exchanges to settle on a system that met my exact needs. The process from there was really simple. They dealt with everything.

Great decision to go with local company Lenergy. The process has been flawless. Quality installation of panels and battery. I’m enjoying the downloaded app which details our usage and what’s going back to the grid. Thanks to the team who spent the day installing our system, friendly, knowledgeable and professional.

Salesman was very informative and easy to understand- discussed several different options for us and when written quote came in it  was easy to compare different options. Easy to contact to discuss.Local company so also a bonus .Installation was punctual, professional and exceptionally neat.

Dear Lenergy,Thank you for the incredible professionalism you showed when installing a new aid conditioning unit and solar cells. You provide accurate information in a timely and comprehensive manner and the installation was carried out on time and I knew what to expect and when. Basically it was a great experience and one I can highly recommend.

Lenergy were top notch throughout my solar and batteries installation. Great communication and knowledge sharing, excellent installation team and great products.I now have a 12KWh solar/16KWh battery system that has pushed my electricity bills down close to zero dollars.

Very professional and friendly staff. Excellent billing/accounts service. External installation contractor Clean Coast Solar were superb. They worked quickly and efficiently in removing my old solar battery system and installing the new system. They demonstrated a very high level of electrical and mechanical expertise in the install. Their staff were all very friendly and went the extra mile in services such as replacing roof tiles that were already damaged. Their post installation training was also excellent. My new system has been tested under maximum load and is working very well.

Lenergy did an outstanding job of installing our new Sonnen battery. We had an existing solar panel system and now we are getting full value from it, because the battery works so well and everything is just so easy - monitoring it through the easy-to-use Sonnen app indicates we're more than 95% self-sufficient. With the government rebates, the price was certainly right! And throughout the process, communication with Lenergy was excellent, both with Matthew Sparke (the engineer we dealt with) and Aysha Manukau (the primary contact in the office). I'm very happy to unreservedly recommend their services.

Goodness me, what a wonderfully simple and satisfying experience. I simply cannot think of any way that this process could have been improved upon. A special shout out to Jeremy who came to my home to explain how everything worked. I warmed to him immediately. He was polite, friendly, punctual, helpful and kind. What a gem! That's not to say that Aysha from accounts or Lachlan, who installed my unit were any less praiseworthy. I could not be happier!

Absolutely recommend Lenergy for your solar panels and battery. Excellent results from our battery reflected in our minimum power bills. From $1000 pq to about $30pq. Currently there is a power outage in our area but we have no interruption to our power supply. The company is very professional and communication was excellent. If you’re getting solar get the biggest system you can manage. Get the biggest battery as it will pay for itself. I highly recommend Lenergy as their product is brilliant and after sales care excellent. Matthew Sparke and team are on top of your solar needs

A knowledge team who have been helpful in achieving our goal of adding batteries to our solar system. The team of installers were excellent and polite, installed the batteries without any fuss. Sadly the batteries have gone off line due to a fault and I await rectification which they are now onto. This fault is not due to Lenergy or the installers but the batteries themselves. I would have no reservations in recommending Lenergy.

And throughout the process, communication with Lenergy was excellent, both with Matthew Sparke (the engineer we dealt with) and Aysha Manukau (the primary contact in the office). I'm very happy to unreservedly recommend their services.

That's not to say that Aysha from accounts or Lachlan, who installed my unit were any less praiseworthy. I could not be happier!

Currently there is a power outage in our area but we have no interruption to our power supply. The company is very professional and communication was excellent. If you’re getting solar get the biggest system you can manage. Get the biggest battery as it will pay for itself. I highly recommend Lenergy as their product is brilliant and after sales care excellent. Matthew Sparke and team are on top of your solar needs

Sadly the batteries have gone off line due to a fault and I await rectification which they are now onto. This fault is not due to Lenergy or the installers but the batteries themselves. I would have no reservations in recommending Lenergy.

Our Lenergy battery system is working very smoothly, and I am trusting it more each day. With the profusion of offers due to the federal government's generous subsidy, we chose a local business so we could get help if we needed it. But we are very happy to see that we need no assistance at all, the Segen batteries charge and disperse silently & we can be happy knowing we are being a bit greener.

Exceptional Service and Trusted ExpertiseRepeat customer - even better the second time!We first had Lenergy install our 10 kWh Sonnen battery, including the inverter and 25 solar panels about two years ago, and we were very happy with the system’s performance and overall workmanship.This year, we returned to Lenergy to install 16 additional panels, upgrade to a 48 kWh Sigenergy battery, and fit a Sigenergy Gateway three-phase 30 kW inverter - and the experience this time was outstanding.A special mention to Charles Dickson, who came out to our property and patiently explained every detail. His product knowledge and communication made the whole process smooth and stress-free.On installation day, Mitchell who led the team was equally impressive, efficient, professional, and clearly experienced. After installation, he took the time to walk us through how the system works and showed us how to use the app to monitor everything.It’s rare these days to find a company that delivers such quality, consistency, and care. Lenergy have truly earned our trust, and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone considering solar or battery storage.

As a licensed builder I was impressed with the no pressure discussion, knowledge on the consultant and the technical information in the design of a battery capacity to match up with the existing solar panel system at my residence. The pricing was catered to my budget and discussion of existing and future demands meant that the system was designed to meet my workshop needs and extended cloudy wintery periods.The electrical installation, cabling and positioning of the batteries was very neat and professional. The whole process was handled by one contractor, Lenergy from design through to grid connection and usage. The process has been handled very professionally and exceeded my expectations of the installation. Being a local company, they are accessible and have real people sitting in an office and actually had Michael call back to site with a query on battery relocation. Well done on an excellent job. I have already recommended Lenergy to some personal friends for their installation needs.
All points above were very good except the installer hadn’t done one of this unit and I don’t really understand how it works. Plus initially it didn’t work until they came back
Had my Sigenergy battery installed by Lenergy and I’m thrilled! The team was super friendly, quick, and tidy. The battery’s already saving me money and it looks great too. Wish I’d done this sooner!

I recently purchased a solar and battery system through Lenergy and couldn’t be happier. Fiona made the sales process clear and easy, Aysha kept me updated and organised everything seamlessly, and the install team led by Ziad did a fantastic, tidy job. Everyone was professional, friendly, and clearly takes pride in their work. Highly recommend Lenergy for quality service and a smooth solar experience!

Everything went smoothly from start to finish. The team were professional, turned up on time, and kept me updated throughout the process. The installation was done neatly, and everything worked perfectly from day one.I’m really happy with how it all went and would definitely recommend this company to anyone considering solar or a battery system.

Lenergy recently installed a battery unit at my home, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, punctual, and easy to work with. They arrived exactly when they said they would, completed the installation efficiently, and left the area clean and tidy.The entire process was smooth, and it was clear that the installers knew exactly what they were doing. They took the time to explain how everything worked and made sure I was completely satisfied before they left.Highly recommend Lenergy to anyone looking for reliable and professional service. Great work!
30kwh battery for $10k vs 16kwh for $11,500.  Turned exactly when they said they would.   Quick and efficient. Good monitoring system.

Had my 24 kWh Sigenergy battery installed by Lenergy, and the whole experience was great from start to finish.Charles made the sales process simple and answered every question clearly, and Aysha in the office kept me updated all the way through.The installers were professional, neat, and quick. The system’s been running perfectly and I’m barely pulling from the grid now and already seeing the savings.Highly recommend Lenergy for anyone looking at solar or batteries, they're really professional and easy to deal with

Every step was effortless for me. Every step was perfectly done by everyone else involved. Great quoting process. Great price. Friendly, professional, helpful, tidy, punctual installation. Friendly, helpful, professional customer service, office staff and accounts staff. What else could I have asked for?

We started our solar journey with Lenergy some ten months ago by making contact with their sales representative, Matthew Sparke. Other competitors were satisfied to simply quote via email or verbally for a battery solution. This was despite explaining some complex 3 phase supply and routing of various incoming and outgoing cabling.Matthew did not hesitate to suggest a site inspection and confirmation of layout, location and suitable sizing.Matthew recommended a 3 phase inverter and battery from Sigenergy. After ordering, suitable arrangements for a team of installers to install and commission the work was arranged. The installation was performed seamlessly within a day with only a 30 minute down time when the mains needed to be switched off. That evening we were running on 3 phase power with no down time or issues. The Sigenergy app worked perfectly from the get go.We have had at least three instances since installation of long duration blackouts – each we did not know had occurred as all appliances were supplied continuously from the battery and showed no loss of power. There have also been numerous of very short power outages that once again we only knew about from notifications via the app.The system is working as designed and we could not be happier with the work of Matthew and the Lenergy team.

Fast, efficient service. Knowledgeable and friendly sales team. Overall, very happy with installation and service. Energy production is as predicted; the app is great to track production. Energy bills have reduced to 1/3 with associated daytime use of appliances. Highly recommend Lenergy

From the planning, final quote and then the installation, everything was done professionally. Work was neat, clean. They were happy to answer all my questions. The office handled all the paperwork and booked the work to change my meter to allow for solar.  I was also provided with an ebook detailing the system including warranties, care instructions etc.

Very happy with the whole process from initial contact right through to system sign off.  Excellent customer service from all areas.  We got a Sonnen battery installed at our house and also got Tesla car chargers installed at three separate locations at the same time, none of which was a problem for Matt and the team, all were great to deal with.  Would recommend them completely.

I obtained recommended solutions and quotes from several different solar companies.Lenergy solution with a 3 phase battery was far better than going with a single phase battery that can only power a subset of my property.The sales process was great, they were happy to create me a few options and change my mind.I also talked to a number of friends, some has used Lenergy and were very happy with their solution.I signed up with Lenergy, and they took care of all the communications with the electricity supplier.They scheduled a date for install, installation team arrived at 07:30 both days and worked solidly. Very polite, and professional. They talked me through the process and where they needed access. They tided the site after each day and left if spotless.Completed the work on time, and very professionally installed. They took time to walk me through the app to monitor my solution and how I could manage configuration settings etc.I had follow-up calls to ensure I was happy with everything and whether I had any queries.They added my older Fronius system to work with the battery and app too.I would 100% recommend Lenergy.

DO NOT USE LENERGY for your Solar Panel Installation…..Well that got your attention!. Didn’t it?Good…..In all seriousness the crew from Moss Vale Lenergy were SENSATIONAL.I don’t often write reviews unless 100% warranted- and in this case, it most certainly is!With a yearly bill of $5-6k in Electricity Costs, and no we don’t waste it nor have a drug lab in the backyard, it was time to invest in the future- due to the rising costs of electricity.I didn’t go into this decision without researching as much as possible.I done the old Google and brought up Finn Peacock and learnt a great deal from the Website and associated forums, plus various other sites and people.I entered my details for 3 Solar Installers to contact me.This is where it fell down as such…..As I live in Moss Vale, I was contacted from a Company in Sydney/ Kiama & Wollongong.One of these companies asked me to send a recent bill , take a photo of my Powerboard on the side of the house and send it through. I done that and he looked at it,(whilst driving), and probably saw the $ signs he could make and said he could drive down on a particular day and time to see me. I stated I work 6 days a week and it didn’t suit. I was then told…well that’s what it is.????Company 2 called and asked what I wanted in a system and told me to send him through the same pictures…2 hours later I had a quote with no onsite visit nor discussion on what panels or system I would need.Company 3 called 10 days later and didn’t seem interested- whatsoever.I thought “shit” this is good isn’t it!I wanted some kind of concrete quote and knowledge before I contacted the local installer-Lenergy at Moss Vale.So then I called Lenergy and was put through to the Solar Salesman Matthew.The conversation was like night and day compared to the other 3 companies.Matthew asked when a time was “suitable for me” and we actually meet the next afternoon at 4pm.In this time I emailed Matthew a recent bill so he knew what he was walking into the following day.The following day Matthew arrived 10mins early and looked very professional and was extremely knowledgeable and caring.He answered all my questions and then we BOTH put together a plan and scenario together in my garage. He was here for close to 2 hours and I remember clearly saying it was time for him to go- due to the fact he was shaking from the cold and I was shaking thinking how much all of this was going to cost me!!!On a side note, which I found absolutely fantastic, was whilst discussing where the battery was going to be put in the garage we decided to move some white goods from one side of the garage to the other. This meant a PowerPoint would become redundant but another PowerPoint would be needed.Before I even asked if his team could do that , Matthew stated he would put in a new PowerPoint….for free!!!Little things like that is Customer Service !!! & over and above of what you expect unfortunately these days.The next day I received a detailed quote…and I mean detailed, on all aspects we chose and a video presentation from Matthew discussing the quote too.How good is this I thought and what a difference from what I received earlier from the other 3 Solar Companies.The day after Matthew contacted me to discuss the quote further and to answer any other questions I had or concerns.I was in 2 minds to go with a “stringer  system” or a “micro inverter” system.Matthew said there is no need for overkill due to the fact I have no shading from trees or obstacles - nor never will in the future. He could have tried to sell me the micro-inverters like the other Company was trying to do for an extra 13k…but didn’t!!I guess when spending a bit of money on something you want to have trust in the person and products your buying….and Matthew was First Class in this field.On the phone calls to each other before signing the contract and then after install etc, every time I call Matthew he answers the phone saying G’Day Graeme.Now that is personalised SERVICE!!!!!!!We choose a 24kw system with 51 Aiko Pure Black Solar Panels(beautiful) and a Sigenergy Battery. Even the racking(rails) are black!!!The battery out rivals the Tesla Powerwall 3. With people now opting not to purchase Tesla vehicles-will batteries be next.We also had our electrical power board upgraded as it was quite messy inside and needed to be simplified to accommodate the new Solar Meter.Lenergy also done this for us - which saved us outsourcing an Electrician - fantastic!I have attached photos for you to view and research if needed.I have also attached photos of my Electricity Bill received today.$0 & a credit just under $300 !!!!Therefore, let’s see how we go now in Winter with less sun and see if it balances out with the costs for the remainder of the year.A special mention to Jacqui and the 2 men that installed our system in 2.5 days. These 3 team members of Lenergy were fantastic.Here on time every day, dressed in full uniform and you could actually have a conversation with them without getting a “grunt or being ignored entirely “.Jacqui briefed me each morning on what was going to be done and then the next day briefed me on what was actually done.Not only that all 3 said “Goodbye and Have a Good Day” before I went to work.Again…..excellent customer service.At the end of the install I came home and all installers had gone. You wouldn’t know anyone had been. Place was clean and tidy!I remember phoning Winston, one of the “Boss’s that afternoon and thanking him so much and commending his team for all that what they done. I think he was a bit taken back- but I meant every word I said….in this regard.At the end of the day we are very happy with our purchase and extremely grateful for the team at Moss Vale Lenergy and would recommend them 110%.They are caring and treat you with respect as well as treating your Solar Quote and needs as an individual….not just a wham bam over inflated package quote.I can truely state all of the above is true and not asked from Lenergy for me to do.At the end of the day do yourself a favour and call this company if you are contemplating Solar and ask for Matthew.You’ll be looked after!
